problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of F(x)=n⁻¹∑ᵢfᵢ(x), with C² components and F(x₀)−inf F≤Δ. Convexity is not required.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: There are n≥1 hidden component functions. All parameters E, n, x₀, κ, ρ, Δ, ε are public; κ≥1, ρ>0, Δ≥0, ε>0.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query chooses an index i and point x and returns the exact component gradient ∇fᵢ(x), jointly with its Hessian. Answers have no oracle noise or history dependence.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact full component Hessian ∇²fᵢ(x) is returned as a continuous linear operator in the same oracle call as the gradient; function values are not returned.

distinctive_assumptions.label: gradient_similarity
distinctive_assumptions.details: Global strong growth: n⁻¹∑ᵢ‖∇fᵢ(x)‖²≤κ‖∇F(x)‖² for every x. Uniform component sampling therefore has gradient variance at most (κ−1)‖∇F(x)‖².

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Mean-square Hessian Lipschitz condition in operator norm: n⁻¹∑ᵢ‖∇²fᵢ(x)−∇²fᵢ(y)‖²≤ρ²‖x−y‖². No global gradient Lipschitz constant or uniform Hessian variance bound is supplied.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The returned point x must satisfy ‖∇F(x)‖≤ε.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: Both stationarity conditions hold jointly on a measurable event with probability at least 2/3, within a fixed oracle budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The same returned point must satisfy ⟨v,∇²F(x)v⟩≥−√(ρε)‖v‖² for every v.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Second-order stationarity is a standard target, but global component-gradient strong growth combined with mean-square Hessian Lipschitz continuity and a joint component gradient–Hessian oracle is a specialized formulation.

descriptionHtml:
Strong-Growth Second-Order Finite-Sum Optimization

We consider minimizing F=n−1∑i=1nfi on a finite-dimensional real inner product space E, with n≥1 components fi:E→R. The twice continuously differentiable components satisfy strong growth and a mean-square Hessian Lipschitz bound with constant ρ>0. The objective may be nonconvex, and a given point x0∈E has bounded objective gap. The oracle returns (∇fi(x),∇2fi(x)) at a queried index i and point x. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E satisfying both ∥∇F(x¯)∥≤ε and ⟨v,∇2F(x¯)v⟩≥−ρε∥v∥2 for every v∈E, with probability at least 2/3 under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is infx∈EF(x),F(x)=1n∑i=1nfi(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, and ∥⋅∥op denotes the induced operator norm. Hessians are linear operators from E to E. The algorithm receives E, n, x0, and the parameters κ≥1,ρ>0,Δ≥0,ε>0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Second-order regularity). Each component fi is twice continuously differentiable. For every x,y∈E, 1n∑i=1n∥∇2fi(x)−∇2fi(y)∥op2≤ρ2∥x−y∥2.

Assumption 2 (Strong growth). For every x∈E, 1n∑i=1n∥∇fi(x)∥2≤κ∥∇F(x)∥2.

Assumption 3 (Initial objective gap). The given point x0 satisfies F(x0)−F(x)≤Δ,x∈E.

Queries may use any index i∈{1,…,n} and any point x∈E. Each oracle call returns the exact component gradient and Hessian together; this pair counts as one call.

After the allotted oracle calls, the required simultaneous accuracy criterion is P({∥∇F(x¯)∥≤ε,⟨v,∇2F(x¯)v⟩≥−ρε∥v∥2for every v∈E})≥23. The event displayed here must be measurable under P.

comparisonHtml:
On a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, F=n−1∑i=1nfi, n≥1, fi∈C2, κ≥1, ρ,ε>0, and F(x0)−F(x)≤Δ for every x. Assume n−1∑i∥∇fi(x)∥2≤κ∥∇F(x)∥2 and n−1∑i∥∇2fi(x)−∇2fi(y)∥2≤ρ2∥x−y∥2. One paired call returns a component gradient and full Hessian. Target: Pr(∥∇F(X)∥≤ε, ∇2F(X)⪰−ρεI)≥2/3.

Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) CoupledCubicStrongGrowth (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) O(κ(d+1)T(1+log⁡T)) paired calls
(2) Full-batch cubic regularization, (Shen et al. 2019), Table 1 O(nT) paired calls; deterministic (1): removes n; asymptotic factor n/[κ(d+1)(1+log⁡T)] when this ratio diverges. (1): adds strong growth and RMS Hessian regularity; probability 2/3 instead of certainty. Worse outside the gain regime; very large leading constant.
(3) STR2 (Shen et al. 2019), Cor. 5.1, Estimator 6 O(n+T[n3/4(1+log⁡T)+nlog⁡(e(d+1)T)]) paired calls, confidence 2/3. Special case: component L1-smoothness and uniform ρ-Hessian Lipschitzness. (1): removes L1; uniform Hessian regularity becomes RMS. On overlap, fixed κ,ρ,Δ, n=ε−1, d=ε−1/4: O(ε−7/4log⁡(1/ε)) versus O(ε−9/4log⁡(1/ε)). (1): adds strong growth; linear dimension cost can lose when κd≳n3/4. Fixed confidence instead of adjustable 1−δ.
(4) PSGD (Roy et al. 2020), Thm. 3.1(a) Gradient-only oracle; half the iterates satisfy second-order accuracy with probability 1−δ. Special case: population gradient smoothness and relative sub-Gaussian gradient tails. (1): selected certified output instead of an unselected collection; drops population gradient smoothness and relative sub-Gaussian tails. (1): requires component Hessians and RMS Hessian regularity; fixed confidence instead of adjustable 1−δ.

Abbr: d=dim⁡E; T=1+ρΔ/ε3/2; Δ≥0 is an initial objective-gap bound. Hessian norms are operator norms. L1 is the component gradient-Lipschitz constant; δ is failure probability. Paired-call bounds count all component evaluations, including refreshes and sampled batches.

import LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

namespace LongTails.Setups.StrongGrowthFiniteSumSecondOrder

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace BigOperators

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  n : ℕ
  [nonzero : NeZero n]
  x0 : E
  κ : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.finiteE Params.nonzero

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := Fin p.n → p.E → ℝ
  Query p := Fin p.n × p.E
  Reply p := p.E × (p.E →L[ℝ] p.E)
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 1 ≤ p.κ ∧ 0 < p.ρ ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f O :=
    (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i)) ∧
    (∀ x, (p.n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      p.κ * ‖gradient (FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f) x‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ x y, (p.n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient (f i)) x - fderiv ℝ (gradient (f i)) y‖ ^ 2 ≤
        p.ρ ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ x, FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f p.x0 -
      FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f x ≤ p.Δ) ∧
    (∀ k seed i x, O.answer k (0, (i, x)) seed =
      (gradient (f i) x, fderiv ℝ (gradient (f i)) x))
  successful p f output P :=
    let event := {ω |
      ‖gradient (FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f) (output ω)‖ ≤ p.ε ∧
      ∀ v, -Real.sqrt (p.ρ * p.ε) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ⟪v, fderiv ℝ (gradient (FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f)) (output ω) v⟫}
    MeasurableSet event ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (P : Measure _) event

end LongTails.Setups.StrongGrowthFiniteSumSecondOrder
